meta.title: DSL Upper Bound — Design System Template

elements.content: A concise subtitle that frames the topic and sets audience expectations for this presentation.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Hero Cover | ANIMATION SET: Cinematic (scale-in, zoom-pop, blur-in — 700-900ms, custom easing) | FX: gradient-blob + starfield for atmospheric depth. Glass card left + concentric rings/orb right. Chips summarize key tags. MACRO CANDIDATE: chip-row component would collapse 6 chip elements into 1 invocation.

elements.content: Brief context or framing for this section of the presentation.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Section Divider | ANIMATION SET: Cinematic (shrink-in, stretch-x, fade-up — 600-800ms) | FX: galaxy-swirl for dramatic pause. Large watermark number + accent bar + title/subtitle. Transition into this slide benefits from autoAnimate 'zoom' mood.

elements.content: Description of the first key feature or pillar. Explain what it does and why it matters to the audience.
Description of the second key feature or pillar. Explain what it does and why it matters to the audience.
Description of the third key feature or pillar. Explain what it does and why it matters to the audience.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Three-Card Feature Layout | ANIMATION SET: Editorial (fade-down, fade-up, fade-right — 500-650ms, staggered delays) | FX: data-stream for technical ambiance. Group elements wrap each card — one animation per group, children inherit. MACRO CANDIDATE: 'feature-card' component would collapse each 5-element group into 1 invocation with props {icon, accent, heading, body}.

elements.content: Key narrative point with supporting evidence
Supporting paragraph that provides context and evidence for the main point. This area can contain up to 3–4 sentences of explanatory text.

• First supporting detail or finding
• Second data point or observation
• Third actionable insight

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Two-Column Content | ANIMATION SET: Editorial (fade-down, fade-up, fade-left — 500-700ms) | FX: constellation for subtle depth. Left: title + body + bullets. Right: glass card visual placeholder. Dashed connector bridges the two. The right glass card is intentionally a placeholder — replace with diagram, image, or code.

elements.content: Trend reveals a clear upward trajectory
Year-over-year growth driven by improved methodology and expanded coverage.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Chart Evidence | ANIMATION SET: Data (step 0 = title, step 1 = chart with blur-in, step 2 = callout with zoom-pop — 500-700ms) | FX: data-stream for analytical atmosphere. Three-step narrative build: context → data → insight. ChartStyle uses typed palette for cross-renderer fidelity.

ARCHETYPE: KPI Dashboard | ANIMATION SET: Data (step 0 = header, step 1 = metric cards with fade-up stagger, step 2 = trend chart with blur-in) | FX: constellation for subtle ambiance. Three metric groups with accent bar + value + caption, plus a bar chart trend strip below. MACRO CANDIDATE: 'metric-card' component would collapse each 5-element group into 1 invocation with props {label, value, caption, accent}.

elements.content: Weighing the strengths against the constraints

• First advantage or strength
• Second positive outcome
• Third benefit area
• Fourth supporting evidence

• First constraint or risk
• Second boundary condition
• Third area for improvement
• Fourth known limitation
Synthesis: the advantages significantly outweigh the limitations for most practical scenarios.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Side-by-Side Comparison | ANIMATION SET: Dramatic (step 0 = title, step 1 = left card, step 2 = right card, step 3 = synthesis thesis) | FX: gradient-blob for atmosphere. Two glass cards with contrasting accent colors (lime = positive, pink = constraints). Bottom thesis synthesizes the comparison. Classic 'strong vs bounded' pattern.

elements.content: Phased rollout with gates between each stage.
Foundation work and validation of core assumptions.
Scale and iterate based on feedback from phase one.
Full deployment with monitoring and optimization.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Horizontal Timeline | ANIMATION SET: Editorial + Dramatic hybrid (step 0 = title + connector line, steps 1–3 = individual phase nodes + cards) | FX: sparkle-trail for progressive energy. Three-phase roadmap with numbered nodes along a horizontal connector. MACRO CANDIDATE: 'timeline-section' component (see macro-authoring-demo) would reduce 18 elements to 1 invocation.

elements.content: Source: Internal analytics dashboard, Q4 reporting period.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Data Table | ANIMATION SET: Data (step 0 = header, step 1 = table with blur-in) | FX: none (clean focus on data). TableStyle uses typed hex colors for cross-renderer fidelity. Theme CSS adds border-radius and box-shadow for HTML polish.

elements.content: Questions, feedback, or next steps — let’s discuss.

slides.notes: ARCHETYPE: Centered Closing | ANIMATION SET: Cinematic (zoom-pop, blur-zoom, fade-up — 700-900ms) | FX: gradient-blob + starfield echoing the cover for bookend symmetry. Centered composition: decorative orb → headline → subtitle → contact. The orb uses the '-orb' naming convention for CSS gradient + screen blend override.
